description: This file defines structures and functions related to pseudo-merge operations in a version control system, including grouping, configuration loading, and bitmap management for pseudo-merges.

classes.name: pseudo_merge_group
classes.description: Represents a group of pseudo-merges based on a pattern and parameters.

classes.name: pseudo_merge_matches
classes.description: Holds stable and unstable commit arrays for a pseudo-merge match.

classes.name: pseudo_merge_map
classes.description: Serialized view of a file containing pseudo-merge data.

classes.name: pseudo_merge
classes.description: Represents an individual pseudo-merge with commit and bitmap data.

methods.name: pseudo_merge_group_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a pseudo_merge_group.

methods.name: load_pseudo_merges_from_config
methods.description: Loads pseudo-merge groups from repository configuration.

methods.name: free_pseudo_merge_map
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a pseudo_merge_map.

methods.name: pseudo_merge_bitmap
methods.description: Loads the bitmap for a pseudo-merge.

methods.name: use_pseudo_merge
methods.description: Loads a pseudo-merge and its commit bitmap.

methods.name: apply_pseudo_merges_for_commit
methods.description: Applies pseudo-merges related to a specific commit to a result bitmap.

methods.name: cascade_pseudo_merges
methods.description: Applies cascaded pseudo-merges based on current bitmap and roots.

methods.name: pseudo_merge_for_parents
methods.description: Finds a pseudo-merge matching a set of parent commits.
